title: Set rider sag and stock spring preload

applicability.included: Exact standard US 2021 Yamaha YZ250F with original stock suspension.
excluded: Other years, modified valving, replacement shock/fork assemblies or springs
Spring replacement or internal shock service

entry_state: Assembled bike with identified original components and serviceable suspension.
exit_state: Rider sag and spring preload measured, adjusted within stock limits and recorded, with locknut secured.
preflight: Use the exact-year diagrams to identify the adjusters and measurement points.
Record current setup before changing it; do not force an adjuster past its stop.

The stock preload ring and locknut must be reachable with suitable tools on the assembled bike. This guide does not remove or refit bodywork, the rear frame or the shock; complete any required access service separately before using it.
critical_stop_conditions: Unidentified component or adjuster; leaks, damage or binding; target setting cannot be reached within actual travel.

required_tools.name: Tools fitting the stock preload ring and locknut

source.review_note: Root independent review approved exact-year settings and diagrams; assembled preload access prerequisite preserved. Physical validation remains outstanding.

steps.title: Prepare the measurement
steps.instruction: Check the shock for leaks and verify smooth suspension/linkage movement. Use level ground and a helper to stabilize the bike and take consistent readings.
verification: Save the actual measurements or setting and outcome.

steps.title: Measure the unloaded bike
steps.instruction: Support the bike under the engine so the rear wheel is off the floor. Measure A from the rear axle center to the rear-fender holding bolt. Use the illustrated points and record the actual millimeters.
verification: Save the actual measurements or setting and outcome.

steps.title: Measure with the rider
steps.instruction: Remove the stand and have the rider sit astride the seat as shown. With the bike held upright, measure B between the same axle center and the rear-fender holding bolt. Record the actual millimeters.
verification: Save the actual measurements or setting and outcome.

steps.title: Calculate rider sag
steps.instruction: Subtract B from A. The standard difference is 90–100 mm. Record both measurements, the difference and whether it is in range.
verification: Save the actual measurements or setting and outcome.

steps.title: Measure and adjust preload
steps.instruction: With the rear wheel raised securely, clean dirt from the locknut and adjusting ring. Loosen the locknut and back off the ring until there is clearance to the spring; measure its free length. Turn the ring in diagram direction b to increase preload or c to decrease it. One turn changes installed length by 1.5 mm. Keep compression from free length within 1.5–18.0 mm; the standard starting preload is 7.0 mm. Record free length, installed length and resulting preload.
verification: Save the actual measurements or setting and outcome.

steps.title: Secure the setting
steps.instruction: Tighten the preload locknut against the adjuster to secure the setting before loading the bike.

steps.title: Repeat and record the result
steps.instruction: Repeat the unloaded A and rider-loaded B measurements at the same points. Adjust within the allowed preload range until A minus B is 90–100 mm, tightening the locknut before each loaded measurement. If the target cannot be obtained within the allowed range, the spring must be changed and the setup repeated in a separate replacement operation. Save the final values; reevaluate after break-in.
verification: Save the actual measurements or setting and outcome.

completeness: Rider sag and spring preload measured, adjusted within stock limits and recorded, with locknut secured.
